proof_scope.above_32_interpretation: Does not prove 32 impossible because parent pricing and omitted component columns remain open.
proof_scope.feasible_32_interpretation: A physically admitted 32-bus incumbent is a baseline-model feasibility result.
proof_scope.physics: covering master; 240 kWh; 240 kW; reserve 0; event time; 2.5 kWh SOC; 5 min blocks; flat tariff; bus coefficient 100000; charge-start fee 5; no shared station capacity; no terminal floor
proof_scope.required_gate: Parent-input replay of every union route, zero rejected or repaired columns, at-least-once parent coverage, hash-bound source journals/status/MIPs and mappings.
